Day One: Thou dost arrive in Tokyo. Thou dost visit the Meiji Shrine. Thou dost stroll through Harajuku. Thou dost taste sushi at Tsukiji. In the even'ng thou dost walk along the Sumida River.  
Day Two: Thou dost travel to Kyoto. Thou dost see Kinkaku-ji. Thou dost walk the Philosopher's Path. Thou dost partake in a tea ceremony in Gion. In the eve thou dost wander Pontocho.  
Day Three: Thou dost journey to Nara. Thou dost behold Todai-ji temple. Thou dost feed the gentle deer. Thou dost return to Kyoto. Thou dost rest in a ryokan.  
Day Four: Thou dost go to Osaka. Thou dost explore Osaka Castle. Thou dost revel in Dotonbori lights. Thou dost sample Kuromon Market. Thou dost delight in takoyaki.  
Day Five: Thou dost return to Tokyo. Thou dost wander Akihabara electric town. Thou dost repose in Shinjuku Gyoen. Thou dost prepare for departure.
